g.text: NOTICE THE RECURSION HERE! The Default
Viewpoint for a Package section is this very section,
instanced within itself. As long as loop is true and you
know there will eventually be no more packages, this is
perfectly valid. (There cannot be infinitely nested
packages. Now if you're looping on a criteria that can be
infinite and is in the model, say an association
composition loop, then you'll be in trouble. The validation
code WILL NOT catch run-time loops like this, not
